correctness.rationale: The frozen verifier exhaustively enumerates all monotone maps \(T\to C\), and a fresh independent replay reproduced exactly 2,836 maps, component sizes \(2828+8\times1\), and homology profile 2,828 zero maps plus two representatives of each signed coordinate class. The one-coordinate-raise lemma is valid: for comparable \(f\le g\), raising a maximal domain point among coordinates where they differ preserves monotonicity, so graph components equal mapping-poset components. The eight isolated maps are exactly the two coordinate projections composed with the four automorphisms of \(C\). The fixed cocycle evaluation on the two canonical factor circles gives the stated \(H_1\) coefficients.
risks: The computation is finite and exhaustive; it is not extrapolated to subdivisions or other torus models.

final_claim: For the standard sixteen-point product finite torus \(T=C\times C\) and four-point minimal finite circle \(C\), the pointwise mapping poset has exactly 2,836 maps in nine finite-space homotopy classes: one 2,828-map null class and eight singleton projection-after-automorphism classes, with induced integral first-homology maps only \((0,0),(\pm1,0),(0,\pm1)\).
limitations: Only the standard product sixteen-point torus and the four-point circle are classified; no claim is made for subdivisions or other finite torus models.
